'division_gate' is the same for every cell of each 'sample', so this test compares 14 samples, not independent clones: whatever differs between samples (library, sort, processing) is read as an effect of 'division_gate', and the p-value counts clones as replicates. Read it as descriptive, or compare

The levels of 'division_gate' (mCherry-high, mCherry-low) have no order, so they are paired in alphabetical order. If they have one (time points, or a path between tissues), pass order=[...] or make the column an ordered pandas Categorical.
